query:
SELECT 
  c.name as canal,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_vendas,
  SUM(s.totalAmount) as total_vendas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN s.totalAmount ELSE 0 END) as total_cancelado,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status != 'CANCELLED' THEN s.totalAmount ELSE 0 END) as total_ativo
FROM sales s
JOIN channels c ON s.channelId = c.id
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.saleDate, '%Y-%m') = '2026-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;
